headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few firms posting strong gains while profit margins pressured.
summary: Revenue grew overall, led by Coforge's 53.6% YoY surge and solid performance from LTM and Tech Mahindra. Profit growth was uneven; HCLTech posted a 21% profit jump, but Wipro and Persistent saw declines. AI contributions were highlighted by several firms but concrete revenue figures were limited. Guidance remained modest, with Infosys trimming FY27 growth expectations and HCLTech introducing a 2.5‑4.0% FY27 target.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Multiple companies cited AI as a growth driver, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins slipped for several peers, while only Coforge raised its EBIT margin guidance.
